completeness: Summary metrics were captured from the actual completed tool result. Original scanner JSON was transformed by a PowerShell summary pipeline and was not persisted. Do not treat this file as original raw JSON.
stdout_transform: PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json then selected summary fields, signature hits and literal candidate groups; human-facing tool output was partly truncated.
redaction: Only paths/rules/blob SHA/offset/length/candidate hashes and review hints were emitted; no candidate values were emitted.
